segments.ja229:1.1: Gajaggameghehi hayaggamālibhi, rathūmijātehi sarābhivassebhi [sarābhivassabhi (syā. sī. aṭṭha.), sarābhivassibhi (?)];
segments.ja229:2.1: [abhidhāvathā ca patathā ca, vividhavinaditā ca dantibhi; vattatajja tumulo ghoso, yathā vijjutā jaladharassa gajjatoti;(sī. pī. ka.)] Abhidhāvatha cūpadhāvatha ca [abhidhāvathā cuppatathā ca (syā.)], vividhā vināditā [vināditattha (ka.)] vadantibhi;
segments.ja229:2.3: Vattatajja tumulo ghoso yathā, vijjulatā jaladharassa gajjatoti [abhidhāvathā ca patathā ca, vividhavinaditā ca dantibhi; vattatajja tumulo ghoso, yathā vijjutā jaladharassa gajjatoti;(sī. pī. ka.)].
